scope: Right-turn launch only. Preserve the official-forward/equal-weight route, original thresholds, every other command and shared raw action history.

component_screen.prospective_input: At 4 seconds, use the same observed yaw-rate channel as the existing gyro feedback. Trigger if the absolute mean over seconds 3 through 4 is at most 0.05 rad/s under the frozen right-turn command.

proposed_dynamic_comparison: If the saved-input screen passes, freeze a small same-batch control and candidate. Keep nominal actions in observation history. Apply the alternate right-turn yaw only to bounded projected destinations while the same observed stall remains, for at most 50 controls. Do not use held-out data for the proposal.
comparability: Hold the GPU batch layout fixed across every comparison arm. Changing batch size for the same model must be evaluated separately.
